'''Qiilura''' was a location in the [[Qiilura system]]<ref name="Episode Guide" /> in the [[Qiilura sector]] of the [[Mid Rim Territories]].<ref name="Appendix" /> In [[20 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TCWcanondates|405}}</ref> the [[104th Battalion]] was redirected from the [[Annexation of the Qiilura system|battlefront]] on Qiilura to aid the [[Aleen]] [[Mission to Aleen|relief effort]].<ref name="Episode Guide" />
